canonical_ownership.official_github_actions_semantics: GitHub-hosted runners and official Actions Runner Controller

owns: bounded workflow YAML parsing and validation
does_not_own: GitHub's expression evaluator or proprietary control plane

request_contract.immutable_commit_sha: exact 40-character lowercase hexadecimal Git commit id
request_contract.workflow_path: direct file under .github/workflows with .yml or .yaml suffix
forbidden: branch or tag as execution authority
secret or OIDC expression in independent-lane input

workflow_parser.unsupported_behavior: return explicit unsupported evidence and do not approximate

execution_contract.normal_lane: official GitHub Actions semantics through ARC or GitHub-hosted runners
execution_contract.independent_lane: compile a fully supported immutable plan to operator-reviewed fixed profiles
execution_contract.transitional_direct_build_server: allowed only for one reviewed endpoint and fixed profile mapping; the clone server must not select arbitrary providers or commands
execution_contract.returned_id_validation: validate syntax and length before constructing poll, log, or artifact URLs

admission_and_scaling.capacity_rule: reserve process-local active-run capacity before API or webhook task creation and release it on every terminal or rejected path
admission_and_scaling.single_replica_rule: webhook execution remains one replica while delivery claims are process-local
admission_and_scaling.horizontal_scaling_gate: use a shared durable claim or Fiducia-fenced delivery claim before multiple replicas enable webhook or API execution

authentication.api: constant-time comparison of a server-owned secret digest
forbidden: personal access token in source or task payload
GitHub App private key in a task payload
shared credential reused across GitHub, planning, and execution boundaries

failure_semantics.ambiguous_build_submission: reconcile by deterministic request id before retry
failure_semantics.github_fetch_failure: leave the delivery retryable when no dispatch claim was committed
failure_semantics.capacity_exhausted: reject or defer before spawning an execution task
failure_semantics.terminal_poll_timeout: record timeout evidence and stop dependent job submission

deployment.artifact_policy: build once, test and sign the exact image, deploy by immutable digest
activation_order: verify exact repository and workflow allowlists
verify fixed profiles and executor routes
